label: Divination Club, Just the Two of Us

lines.text: And so, Arcana and I officially form our very own divination club.
Arcana sits across from me in the clubroom.
She deliberately puts on an air of mystery and peers into a crystal ball.
What do you see?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That's not how you ask.
Then how am I supposed to?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: You should ask, "Do you see anything?"

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Because...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I can't see anything at all!
Uh, I mean...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Come on. There's no way you can see the future or fate just by staring into a glass ball.
Isn't that what fortune-tellers and prophets are supposed to do?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That's true, but I'm neither of those.
Then what are you?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm a cold, ruthless, and professional city woman.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hmm... let's see...
Arcana places both hands on the crystal ball and falls deep into thought.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Right now... oooh...!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I see it...! My future...!
Isn't it usually impossible to see your own future?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That may be true for ordinary prophets.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: But I'm not ordinary at all! I'm in a class of my own!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: In other words, a legendary prophet like no other.
Dozens of retorts come to mind,
but Arcana looks so happy that I decide to let it go.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oooh, isn't that...!
Arcana hurriedly takes out some stones, spreads them across the desk,
and begins to study them seriously...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oooh, I see. Mm-hmm. Now I get it.
... What is it?
If you say it's a secret, I'm seriously going to be mad.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's a secret.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's a s—heh.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: A s...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: A storm! It's going to rain! Ahaha!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... I-I'm just kidding! You don't have to glare at me like that.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: For stuff like this, atmosphere and momentum make up about 200% of it.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If you grab their attention like this right from the start...!
Arcana spreads tarot cards across the desk.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Even if things don't quite add up, they'll just go along with it!
... Isn't that just a scam?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hey now.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Like I said before, it's kind of like counseling.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: People only see what they want to see,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: and believe what they want to believe.
Arcana flips over one card.
The Star.
Arcana hesitates, then flips over another card.
The Moon.
Aren't you supposed to flip three cards?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, right! Yeah.
Arcana starts to flip another card, but stops.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Eh. This is boring.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Let's do something else.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Next up!
Arcana takes out a wooden board with letters written on it.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: A spirit board.
What do you do with that?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Mmm... to put it simply, you summon a spirit and ask it things.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I figured it'd be more fun if we did it together.
What are you planning to ask?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: About that... there are more restrictions than you'd think.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: There are some things you're not supposed to ask.
Man, these spirits sure are strict.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Right? I mean, they should be grateful a living person is even talking to them.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Anyway, I'll give you a rough explanation, so listen up.
As Arcana begins to explain various things, I suddenly speak up.
Hold on.
You used to do stuff like this when you were alone in the Forbidden Library, right?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... Yeah, pretty much.
... Because you were lonely?
Arcana sets the planchette down.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Actually, one of the biggest taboos with a spirit board is using it alone.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: But honestly, ghosts and curses don't really scare me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I just... wanted someone, anyone, to talk to.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Argh!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Why did things suddenly get like this again?!
H-huh?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I've told you all that before!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: All of it!
Arcana gets up from her seat and walks over briskly.
She sits down next to me and hooks her arm around mine.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... That was all before I met you, though.
I got it, I got it.
... But why are you not calling me by my name anymore?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Because this something I'm saying to you as a fellow classmate, not as an upperclassman.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Uh, um. It's just one of those things.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Anyway.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Don't keep bringing that up, okay?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I've been really happy since I met you.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Even now, being with you is so much fun.
... Got it.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Mm-hmm.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Well then.
Arcana picks up the spirit board's planchette.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Let's start again.
Starting with the spirit board,
I spend the entire day listening to Arcana lecture me about all kinds of fortune-telling and occult-related things.
Later, on the way back after leaving the clubroom together...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh, right! I'm supposed to have dinner with Amy today.
Mind if I come along?
Have a good meal.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Of course! Even if you said you weren't going, I was planning to drag you along.
You were?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yup! You only get one school life, after all.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's good to get along with your friends too, you know.
Mmm...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... You disagree?
It's not that, exactly.
It's just that I like spending time alone with you more.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Do you like spending time with me, or do you like me?
Arcana smiles softly and glances around.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh... you're not going?
It'd be kind of awkward if I tagged along.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Oh no, not at all!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: If anything, Amy would be happy to see you.
Is it still awkward when it's just the two of you?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: N-no, th-that's n-not it at all. O-of course not!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: We're super close! We're basically best friends!
I think you're protesting a bit too much...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: N-no! I'm serious!

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's just...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I only brought it up so you wouldn't feel pressured. No need to be mean about it.
Y-you did?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah...
... I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Are you really?
Y-yeah.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Then you'll come along, right?
I had a feeling this would happen...
Okay...

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hehe. Thank you.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Since it's just the two of us in the club, I wanted the three of us to hang out sometimes too.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Ah, speaking of which...
Arcana stops walking and glances around.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Spending this much time together,

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: just the two of us... it's a first.
Yeah.
It's not easy getting inside the Forbidden Library that often, after all.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Yeah, well... I can come out more often now that I used to.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: But it's still only for short periods.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Ah, right.
Hmm?
Arcana stops and holds out a tarot card.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: This.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It's not the Wheel of Fortune.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Earlier, I only flipped two cards instead of three.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: This was the third.
I take the tarot card.
It's The Lovers.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: That card comes up all the time when I'm with you.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: It must be fate!
I don't think that's what you think it means.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Hey, what did I say before?
Tarot is all about interpretation.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Correct!
Arcana starts walking again.
I slip the card in my pocket and follow after her.
*Step, step*

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: ... {AccountData.NickName}.
Yes?

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: Thank you for staying with me.

lines.speaker: arcana_s
lines.text: I'm really happy we can be alone together.
Yeah. Me too.
